items.title: Joby Aviation's Autonomous Flight Milestone
points: Aircraft equipped with Joby's autonomous system completed a 3,199-mile cross-US flight with zero control inputs from the onboard safety pilot.
System autonomously handled the full flight envelope: taxiing, takeoff, cruising, and landing, while being monitored remotely.
Company envisions applications ranging from cargo delivery to disaster response operations.

items.title: Heat-Tolerant 'Fire Amoeba' Discovery
points: A newly found amoeba species in California's geothermal hot springs can actively grow at 63°C (145°F), the highest temperature confirmed for any complex lifeform.
The organism survives even hotter conditions by entering a dormant state (a low-activity survival mode), showing extreme heat adaptation.
Scientists identified specific protein adaptations that prevent heat damage, offering clues to the thermal limits of life.

items.title: AI-Assisted Biology Discovery
points: Claude-powered AI agents (AI systems that can autonomously perform multi-step tasks) scanned a database of 1.9 billion protein clusters (groups of proteins with similar structure/function) to identify a previously unknown enzyme system (a set of proteins that catalyze biochemical reactions).
Researchers used the AI not merely as an assistant but as an active discovery tool, signaling a shift toward AI-driven scientific breakthroughs.
The finding is unreviewed and unverified; outside scientists say extensive lab testing is needed before validation.

items.title: Mysterious 'Hypersoft' X-ray Sources Found
points: Researchers identified 84 mysterious 'hypersoft' X-ray sources across nearby galaxies using decades-old NASA data.
The discovery could help explain the formation of certain types of supernovas (exploding stars).

Researchers find 84 mysterious "hypersoft" X-ray sources across nearby galaxies using decades-old NASA data, potentially explaining formation of certain supernovas.
